name: Tempered
description: Adds flat Armour. The workhorse defensive prefix for plates and shields.

name: Vital
description: Adds flat maximum Health. Keeps a Soul-Spark bound through a bad telegraph.

name: Warded
description: Adds flat maximum Ward, the shield that absorbs damage before Health.

name: Mighty
description: Adds Might: weapon damage, melee power, crit multiplier and armour break.

name: Swift
description: Adds Agility: attack speed, double-hit chance, DoT speed and dodge.

name: Wise
description: Adds Wisdom: cast speed, mana, ward and ailment potency.

name: Stout
description: Adds Fortitude: health, health regen, armour and thorns.

name: Sharp
description: Adds flat critical strike chance. Critical hits roll 1.35x floating text.

name: Brutal
description: Increases critical strike multiplier. Makes crits hit like a boss slam.

name: of Haste
description: Increases attack speed, filling the weapon auto-attack bar faster.

name: Cinder
description: Increases Fire damage. Feeds Ignite.

name: Rime
description: Increases Frost damage. Feeds Chill and Freeze.

name: Storm
description: Increases Lightning damage. Feeds Shock.

name: Voidbound
description: Increases Void damage. Feeds Corruption, which ignores armour.

name: Bloodletting
description: Increases Physical damage. Feeds Bleed.

name: of the Bitter Root
description: Increases ailment potency, raising every Bleed, Ignite, Chill, Shock and Corruption.

name: of Mending
description: Adds flat health regeneration per second.

name: of the Deep Well
description: Adds flat maximum Mana, letting the rotation fire more skills.

name: of Insight
description: Adds flat Mana regeneration per second.

name: of the Ember Ward
description: Adds Fire resistance. Resistance follows a soft curve capped at 75%.

name: of the Rime Ward
description: Adds Frost resistance.

name: of Grounding
description: Adds Lightning resistance.

name: of Purity
description: Adds Void resistance.

name: of Greed
description: Increases Gold found from kills.

name: of Plunder
description: Increases the chance of gear and gems from kills.

name: Barbed
description: Adds flat thorns damage returned to attackers.

name: of Evasion
description: Adds dodge rating, the entropy-dodge defence against streak deaths.

name: Sweeping
description: Increases area damage for cleaves and AoE skills.

name: of Thirst
description: Adds life leech, capped at 6% maximum Health per second.

name: of the Last Word
description: Deals more damage to enemies below 35% Health.

name: Arcane
description: Increases spell damage for every cast-bar skill.

name: of Quickening
description: Increases cast speed, shortening the dedicated cast bar.

name: Precise
description: Adds double-hit chance for attacks, capped at 75% total.

name: Warden
description: Increases maximum Ward by a percentage.

name: of the Ley Line
description: Increases Mana regeneration by a percentage.

name: Aegis
description: Increases maximum Ward by a percentage.
